name: Heinrich Rusche
headline: CRO at Building Radar | Ex-McKinsey | INSEAD MBA | Firm Learning
summary:
Creator of "Firm Learning", a YouTube channel on Consulting and Career Success with 200k+ subscribers. My mission with Firm Learning is to help you become successful in the first years of your career. I share my learnings and experiences from my time in consulting at McKinsey and my subsequent career in industry and start-up.

I offer corporate trainings on Communications, Slide Writing and Problem Solving Skills.

As Chief Revenue Officer at Building Radar, I lead the commercial operations of this European, fast growing property technology start-up. We aim to revolutionize the sales function of leading players in the construction industry. We are based in Munich.

Passionate about Business, Consulting, Real Estate, Entrepreneurship and Digital Technology.

company.description:
Data in. Revenue out. 

With Building Radar, sales teams in the construction industry systematically win new projects and unlock their full revenue potential.
Our market-leading Revenue Engineering platform enables scalable sales - with less manual effort and regardless of your preferred sales approach.

No more scattered information:
Our personalized AI analyzes and connects project opportunities from all sources - whether emails, newsletters, articles, Excel lists, construction signs, or LinkedIn profiles.

Less effort, more focus:
Complex tenders and specifications are automatically summarized. Our AI links new projects with information from existing deals, and enriches incomplete project data using our extensive database.

Clear prioritization through AI-powered lead scoring:
Stay focused on the most promising project opportunities - at exactly the right time, in the right place.

All your sales knowledge in one place: Structured and centralized on one platform - and seamlessly integrated into your CRM system.

Companies like Schüco, Viessmann, and Holcim have already realized over €2 billion in revenue potential with Building Radar.
